description: Severity-based censorship policy. Admins can switch strict_mode in the governance panel; everything else is edited here.

CRITICAL.summary: Always censored with a descriptive placeholder; the original value never reaches the LLM. The request is blocked when safe redaction is not possible.

HIGH.summary: Automatically redacted with a category-specific placeholder before forwarding; the rest of the prompt is preserved and the user is notified.

MEDIUM.summary: The user is warned and can review the items, then choose to redact them or send anyway. In strict mode they are redacted automatically.

LOW.summary: Not censored. Shown as an informational note only.
